blind.second_guess: stylized rock slab with mineral vein
blind.description: A rectangular, freestanding stylized stone slab or dungeon wall segment with hand-painted textures. It depicts chiseled ochre-brown rock cracked diagonally by a prominent Y-shaped vein of rounded, glossy orange/amber ore nuggets. The structure is solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled with beveled faceted edges, standing directly on the floor with no external base.
blind.from_above: A thick, rectangular slab top showing a flat, beveled tan-brown rock surface with slight orange bumps protruding from the front and back faces, casting a long shadow towards the upper-left.
blind.height_vs_figure: Slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (approx. 7 to 7.5 ft tall), and about 3.5 to 4 ft wide.
